segments.he: מרבינו ז"ל שראה א' שהי' לו קריעה בבגדו על מתו ואמר לו שהעצבות (שהי' איש עצבן) גרם לו זאת הקריעה רח"ל היינו שמת לו מת (וכמובא בס' המדות שצריך ליזהר מעצבות שלא יבא לידי אבילו רח"ל).
segments.en: After Rosh Chodesh Nisan — after that Purim — he came once from the holy grave, having stayed there much longer than usual. When he came to Reb Naftali, Reb Naftali saw a new expression in his face — that he was not as on previous days. And Moharan'as told him: "It seems I can already return home." Then Reb Naftali gave him the letters that had arrived — and he read them and said he would look at nothing and would return home [for he recognized from his prayer at the holy grave that it had been accepted and he could return]. And so it was — he returned home before Pesach. And the opponents gnashed their teeth at him — but the fear of G-d fell upon them and they did not touch him, for they had already seen some miracles by then.
